description: This file defines a protocol and helper functions for handling location services, including requesting location updates and managing authorization status, within an iOS/macOS application.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Configures the CLLocationManager by setting delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status of the location manager.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Retrieves the accuracy authorization (full or reduced accuracy) for location updates.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update.
